item.title: Sudan's civil war: the situation
item.description:

The RSF also attacked a Red Crescent volunteer and a livestock market in Nyala, killing and injuring dozens of women and children, while the SAF blamed the RSF for a market bombing in Darfur. El Niño has contributed to a humanitarian crisis, killing hundreds of children. A Russian diplomat alleges that US weapons supplied to Ukraine have been found in RSF possession. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Ethiopia: the situation
item.description:

The United States is urging Ethiopia and Eritrea to de-escalate the conflict. Hospitals in Tigray have resumed operations as supplies arrive. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
